inputModel: V4 TestTableBuilder fixture + real TileMovement calls. The only preparatory action is a real TileMovement.draw for the closed-kan and added-kan cases so the drawn tile has a production source (WALL), not a preset fixture value.

mapping.v4ToCsharpPosition: V4 wall index -> C# Wall(index); V4 deadWall index -> C# DeadWall(index); V4 deadWallReplacements index -> C# DeadWallReplacement(index); V4 hand (allClosedTiles sorted by tileId) -> C# Hand(seat, dense sorted slot); V4 meld list index -> C# Meld(seat, meldIndex*4 + offset of tileId-sorted tiles); V4 discards list index -> C# Discard(seat, listIndex); V4 sleeve list index -> C# Sleeve(seat, listIndex).
mapping.v4ConsumedDeadWall: V4 keeps the consumed rinshan tile in the deadWall list while rinshanPointer advances; the canonical placement uses the TilePool location (HAND/DISCARD), never DeadWall, for indices below rinshanPointer. C# requires those dead-wall slots to be empty.
mapping.v4StaleLastDiscard: V4 leaves lastDiscard/lastDiscardPlayer pointing at a tile that a call already moved out of the river, and TileMovement.draw/drawRinshan do not clear a still-valid lastDiscard. C# TilePositionMap clears LastDiscard on a successful draw/call and sets it on discard. Canonical lastDiscard therefore follows the C# evidence; the raw V4 value is kept in v4RawLastDiscard as SOURCE_ONLY.
mapping.meldMetadata: C# TilePositionMap stores only physical meld slots, not MeldType/fromPlayer/calledTile. The fixture exports that metadata as SOURCE_ONLY; the C# test compares physical groups only.
mapping.kanCount: TileMovement does not update GameState.totalKanCount; the application layer does. C# TilePositionMap increments KanCount on kan transitions. It is exported as v4TotalKanCount (SOURCE_ONLY) and is not part of the physical diff.
mapping.handSlots: V4 hand is a sorted list, not a slot-addressed array. Hand slots are therefore canonicalized to dense 0..n-1 in tileId order on both sides; wall/discard/meld/dead-wall slots remain exact.
mapping.lastRinshanEvidence: C# LastRinshanDraw is a V5 representation derived from the successful drawRinshan action; V4 has no such field.

UNREPRESENTABLE: V4 TilePool and C# positions are different ledgers; C# is immutable single-ledger

scope.note: Only G-004..G-007 are covered. The frozen catalogue/manifest and the five accepted fixtures are not changed. This is not a full 73-case audit and not G1/G5 acceptance.

cases.title: normal draw then discard preserves exact identity and river history
notes: draw and discard are recorded as two steps in the same case

cases.title: pon transfers all three physical copies and clears the source river
cases.fixture: Pin5 c0/c1 in seat0 hand; Pin5 c3 in seat2 river; phase=RESPONSE_WINDOW, currentPlayer=2
notes: lastDiscard is valid before the call; V4 leaves it stale afterwards, canonical C# evidence is null

cases.title: chi transfers both hand tiles and the called discard
cases.fixture: Man2 c2/Man3 c2 in seat0 hand; Man4 c2 in seat3 river; phase=RESPONSE_WINDOW, currentPlayer=3
notes: kamicha constraint and sequence shape are both exercised by the real call

cases.title: closed kan preserves an unrelated drawn tile and replenishes the dead wall
cases.fixture: Sou8 c0..c3 in seat0 hand; phase=DRAW; a real draw(0) obtains the unrelated drawn tile
notes: the preparatory draw is a real TileMovement.draw, so drawnTile.source is WALL; closedKan merges it into closedTiles and clears drawnTile

cases.title: added kan consumes the just drawn fourth copy exactly once and replenishes the dead wall
cases.fixture: Pin6 c0..c2 in a seat0 PON meld; wallPrefix=[Pin6 c3]; phase=DRAW; real draw(0) obtains c3
notes: the drawn fourth copy is consumed from drawnTile, not from closedTiles; drawRinshan follows

cases.title: open kan removes the discard, transfers all four tiles and replenishes the dead wall
cases.fixture: Sou7 c0..c2 in seat0 hand; Sou7 c3 in seat2 river; phase=RESPONSE_WINDOW, currentPlayer=2
notes: the called discard leaves the river; all four copies enter MELD

cases.title: duplicate physical copies in a pon fail before mutation
cases.fixture: Man5 c0 in seat0 hand; Man5 c3 in seat2 river; pon hand input [c0, c0]
notes: V4 throws IllegalArgumentException; C# returns typed InvalidMeldShape and leaves the map untouched

exception.message: Pon tiles contain duplicate copies: [Tile(suit=MAN, rank=5, copyIndex=0), Tile(suit=MAN, rank=5, copyIndex=0), Tile(suit=MAN, rank=5, copyIndex=3)]

cases.title: fifth rinshan draw cannot consume a dead-wall/dora tile
cases.fixture: TestTableBuilder.create(phase=DRAW); four complete drawRinshan+discard steps; fifth drawRinshan
notes: the four successful steps move replacement tiles into deadWallReplacements; the fifth is rejected with the 136-placement state unchanged

exception.message: Rinshan tiles exhausted: pointer=4 (must be in 0..3 for at most 4 rinshan draws)
